title: EB-I22 whole-column sensible-energy current-canonical postimage reconciliation
hard_nonclaims: F-CI70P reconciles the F-CI70 canonical postimage and installs dependency-scoped moving-current preservation only.
F-CI70P introduces no production or reference source change.
F-CI70P does not materialize all four sensible-energy boundary categories in the production runtime.
F-CI70P does not publish a whole-column sensible-energy residual from an accepted transaction.
F-CI70P does not claim net radiation, latent heat, vapor energy, freeze-thaw enthalpy, snow phase-change closure or a complete SWAP5 Energy Balance.
A runtime whole-column sensible-energy residual must remain fail-closed until coherent accepted-transaction boundary authorities are bound under one reference-temperature convention.
